turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct: my son found out about a zero from his phone, in class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
Don't thank me, Hale. I'm here because nobody called me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
Don't manage me, Hale. Answer the question: was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
"Following the evidence." You haven't named a single piece of it yet, Hale. What do you have, and when did you have it?
